analysis.processing_rate_note: No source-counter reset was observed. This processing rate uses the first and last runtime samples; the sampling interval is recorded separately from the formal event window.

gpu.note: GPU CSV collected by the CPU helper via existing Savant containers. Sample-observed timestamps are kept separately from the original nvidia-smi timestamp; no system clocks were changed.

unverified_uuid_check.note: Original quality failure states are retained. Frame UUID/timeline checks diagnose guard discrepancies; they do not assert frame-accurate centering of every video.

note: Source-isolated follow-up using one upstream H264 RTSP session shared locally to 60 independent source adapters. Business parameters remain unchanged; movie offsets differ. Reader isolation and GPU telemetry are verified separately. Event coverage is not established by saved-video timing alone. Original event/evidence timestamps are preserved.

all_video_decode.method: FFmpeg software decode of every frame with -xerror, 2 codec threads, four files concurrently; performed after the formal load. This does not verify event coverage or centering.

shared_input.method: One H264 upstream session shared on uos157 via GstRtspServer, without decode/reencode/sampling. Sixty independent local source adapters still perform normal analysis/recording. This validates this input topology, not sixty physical remote cameras.

decoder_guard_metrics.note: Differences between first and last successful samples inside the formal hour; excludes warmup and up to one sampling interval at each edge. Exporter adds a second _total suffix, retained in raw metrics.

budget_metrics.note: Admissions are a lower bound because queue-full rejection/eviction has no separate counter. In-flight sends may cause small endpoint differences. Frame-equivalent seconds are not measured detection outages.

overall_observed_acceptance_reasons: At least one required video was missing or exceeded the 180-second registration deadline.
Some required video files were never generated.
The existing pressure harness still reports failing gates; see the separate gate list.
detection_coverage_note: No annotated event ground truth was supplied. Saving every generated required event is distinct from detecting every possible event; guard/stale/resync drops may lose events.

camera_source_id_restoration.followup_reason: Initial restoration expected only source_id changes. This shared-relay run also intentionally changed rtsp_url. Both fields are restored from the pretest snapshot; the original failed attempts remain in supervisor-status.json.

harness_ffprobe_limitation: The CPU API helper has no ffmpeg or ffprobe binary, independently confirmed after the formal load. Its evidence_clip_frame_rate_missing gate cannot establish an actual file defect. Every existing formal video is independently decoded and probed using the existing media-worker image; raw harness failures are retained.
